operator_assessment.operator_summary: Targeted repair of the Kongsberg U9 temporal_clustering finding: rvv-0184 moved from 2027-02-20 to 2027-02-14 (swapped date/time only with the U11 tournament rvv-0145 at Holmen; both keep their own arena/host), bringing Kongsberg U9's spacing to a 7-day minimum gap (was 1 day) across rvv-0184 (Feb 14), rvv-0156 (Feb 21, restored to its valid pre-experiment slot), and rvv-0142 (Feb 28). Deterministic hard verification passes with zero violations, no new fixed-busy/manual/host-confirmation placement was introduced, and export formats are internally consistent.

key_tradeoffs.title: Ringerike 2 (U11) loses a participation slot in the displaced tournament
key_tradeoffs.summary: Moving rvv-0145 to 2027-02-20 double-booked Ringerike 2, so the bounded same-age roster repair substituted Frisk Asker 1 for Ringerike 2. This resolves a pre-existing Frisk Asker 1 season shortfall but creates a new Ringerike 2 under-target-by-1 deviation (after_christmas and season scope), classified bounded_search_exhausted (a strong-goal deviation, not a hard-rule violation). The repository's own consequence check (consequence_acceptable) confirms this does not cross the materiality thresholds for spacing, coverage, opponent repetition, or travel.

key_tradeoffs.title: New same-club-triple in rvv-0145 (3 Frisk Asker teams)
key_tradeoffs.summary: The roster substitution raises Frisk Asker's count in rvv-0145 from 2 to 3 teams, which the exported audit evidence classifies as a visible-exception case under the '3 teams from one club is a visible exception' rule (checklist item 7), not a hard violation.

remaining_actions.title: Pre-existing season-wide findings are unchanged and out of scope for this fix
remaining_actions.summary: hosting_balance_imbalances (12), external_calendar_conflicts (2), movable_host_confirmation_required (1, rvv-0053 Kongsberg U12 open-ice), participation_shortfalls (101) and other temporal_clustering findings (72 remaining) are pre-existing and were not targeted by this Kongsberg U9 repair. Publication readiness remains REVIEW_REQUIRED for these unrelated reasons.

limitations: This audit focused on verifying the Kongsberg U9 repair introduced no new operational regression; it did not re-review the full season's pre-existing open findings, which are unchanged by this change.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Kongsberg U9 now plays rvv-0184 (Feb 14), rvv-0156 (Feb 21), rvv-0142 (Feb 28) with 7-day gaps throughout, resolving the prior 1-day clustering. Pre-existing per-club/age participation shortfalls elsewhere (e.g. other Kongsberg age groups, Ringerike 2 U11) are unchanged in kind by this fix except the one deliberate roster substitution described below.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Hosting responsibility unchanged: rvv-0184 stays hosted by Kongsberg at Kongsberghallen, rvv-0145 stays hosted by Holmen at Holmen ishall. Only date/start_time were exchanged between the two tournaments.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: rvv-0184 (155 min, 5 rounds, 20 games) and rvv-0145 (140 min, 5 rounds, 15 games) durations are unchanged from before the swap; only the calendar date/time moved.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Repository operational-acceptability re-check at the apply boundary reports zero regressions: fixed_busy_placement, manual_calendar_placement and host_confirmation_dependency counts are unchanged before/after (2, 0, 1 respectively), and rvv-0184/rvv-0145's new date/arena/time combinations do not fall inside any fixed_busy or untrusted-calendar interval.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: Kongsberg participates in its own hosted rvv-0184 (unchanged), and Holmen participates in its own hosted rvv-0145 (unchanged).

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: No team is double-booked by this change: the roster repair specifically replaced Ringerike 2 in rvv-0145 because it would otherwise have played twice on 2027-02-20, substituting Frisk Asker 1 (verified free on that date).

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: The Ringerike 2 -> Frisk Asker 1 substitution raises Frisk Asker's count in rvv-0145 from 2 to 3 teams. This is flagged by the exported evidence as a visible 3-team exception (checklist item 7), not a hard violation, and is a direct, explained consequence of the coupled repair's bounded same-age roster substitution.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary reports no mismatches: csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical and excel row/event counts all match the plan (178 tournaments, 2269 games, 51 pause rows).

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new material problem was found beyond the two already-flagged trade-offs (items 6/7 consequence and the new Ringerike 2 season/half participation shortfall, which mirrors a shortfall Frisk Asker 1 previously had and which is now resolved). Pre-existing season-wide findings (hosting balance imbalances, external calendar conflicts, other temporal_clustering clusters, broad participation shortfalls) are unrelated to and unchanged by this targeted repair.
